collection.name: Ceres' Modyard - Dubious Engineering Ships & Vanilla Weapons Resprites

mods.name: Dubious Engineering
mods.summary: Five bizarre ships, sprites that were first made as a joke but found themselves becoming real. These all represent post-collapse attempts at producing something viable from older hulls.
mods.aiSummary: Adds five salvage retrofit ships with unusual weapon mounts to pirate and independent fleets.

mods.name: Vanilla Weapons Resprites
mods.summary: It's very simple - some repainted sprites of a few vanilla weapons according to my personal taste. Some are very light touchups of the original design, others less so. I may or may not add more in future, whims depending.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces the sprites of several vanilla weapons with repainted versions.
